Construction of epidemics
=========================
Parameters
----------
Since we shall only use artificial examples,
we do not define the rate parameters.
```{julia}
const duration = 5.0;
const initial  = SIR(0.0, 4, 1, 0);
```

Construction of unconditioned epidemic
--------------------------------------
Here is an `Innovation` to generate the `Evolution` of the unconditioned epidemic:
```{julia}
A = AbstractInfection; I = Infection; P = PInfection; R = Removal; C = CRemoval;
infections = A[I(2t-1, t, t+1) for t in [1,2]] ∪ A[I(0,3,4), I(2,4,5)]
uremovals  =  [R(2t, t) for t in [1,2]] ∪ [R(1,5), R(3,5), R(4,5)]

uiv1 = Innovation(initial.n, infections, uremovals)
```
The `Evolution` of an (_unconditioned_) epidemic is given by:
```{julia}
uev1 = Evolution(initial, uiv1)
```

Construction of conditioned epidemic
------------------------------------
Here is an `Innovation` to generate the `CEvolution` of the corresponding conditioned epidemic:
```{julia}
removals   =  [R(1,5), R(3,5), R(4,5)]
cremovals  =  [C(2t, t) for t in [1,2]] 

iv1 = Innovation(initial.n, infections, removals, cremovals)
```
The `CEvolution` of an (_conditioned_) epidemic is given by:
```{julia}
ev1 = CEvolution(initial, iv1)
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

Displaying evolution of epidemics
=================================
Preliminaries
-------------
We import from `EpidemicsUtilities` some constants 
that can be used for the keyword argument `select`
used by the functions `draw_regions!`, `draw_innovation!`, `draw_evolution!`.
```{julia}
import EpidemicsUtilities: TOP, BOUNDARIES, REGIONS, 
    INFECTIONS, REMOVALS, CREMOVALS, ACTIVATED, 
    ELEMENTS, BASIC, ALL 
```

Tables and plots
----------------
Here are the epidemics defined in the previous sub-sections, both unconditioned and conditioned,
both as tabulated trajectories (@tbl-test-01, the same for both unconditioned and 
conditioned versions)
and figures (@fig-test-01-unconditioned, @fig-test-01-conditioned).

```{julia}
#| label: tbl-test-01
#| tbl-cap: Versions of locally-authored software packages used below _etc_.
#| echo: false 
uflow = table_trajectories1(duration, uev1.trajectory) ;
header = [:t, :susceptibles, :infectives, :removals, :epidemic]
Markdown.parse(pretty_table(String, uflow[:,header], 
  header=header, tf=tf_markdown, alignment=[:l, :c, :c, :c, :c]))
```


```{julia}
#| echo: false
curves_template = plot(uflow, yintercept=1:initial.n,
    Geom.hline(style=:dash, size=0.1mm, color=theme.scaffold),
    Coord.cartesian(xmin=0, xmax=duration, ymin=0, ymax=initial.n + 0.25),
    Guide.xlabel("Process time", orientation=:horizontal),
    style(default_color=theme.background),
    gadfly_theme) ;

push!(curves_template, layer(uflow, x=:t, y=:empty, Geom.line,
    style(line_width=2theme.trail, default_color=theme.scaffold))) ;

incidents_template = new_figure(curves_template,
    Scale.y_continuous(labels=(initial.n ≤ EpidemicsUtilities.MAXPOP ?
        i -> EpidemicsUtilities.timelinelabels_circled(i; n=initial.n) :
        i -> EpidemicsUtilities.timelinelabels_bracketed(i; n=initial.n))),
    Guide.yticks(ticks=collect(1:(initial.n))),
    Guide.ylabel("Time lines")) ;

figure_zones = draw_regions!(deepcopy(incidents_template), duration, uflow,
    uev1, theme=theme, select=BOUNDARIES | REGIONS)
depict("test-01-unconditioned", new_figure(
    draw_evolution!(deepcopy(figure_zones), uev1, theme=theme, select=BASIC),
        title="Evolution of unconditioned epidemic")
) ;

depict("test-01-conditioned", new_figure(
    draw_evolution!(deepcopy(figure_zones), ev1, theme=theme, select=BASIC),
        title="Evolution of conditioned epidemic")
) ;
```

Unit tests for unconditioned and conditioned `AbstractEvolution`s
=================================================================
```{julia}
trajectory = [SIR(0,4,1,0), SIR(1,3,2,0), SIR(2,3,1,1), SIR(3,2,2,1), SIR(4,2,1,2)]
@testset "EpidemicsCFTP: $(rpad(Evolution, 23))" begin
    history    = [I(1,1,2), R(2,1), I(3,2,3), R(4,2)]
    @test uev1.infections == sort(infections, lt=isearlier)
    @test uev1.removals   == sort(uremovals,  lt=isearlier)
    @test uev1.chronology == sort(infections ∪ uremovals, lt=isearlier)
    @test uev1.trajectory == trajectory
    @test uev1.history    == history
end
@testset "EpidemicsCFTP: $(rpad(CEvolution, 23))" begin
    history    = [I(1,1,2), C(2,1), I(3,2,3), C(4,2)]
    @test ev1.infections == sort(infections, lt=isearlier)
    @test ev1.removals   == sort(removals,   lt=isearlier)
    @test ev1.chronology == sort(infections ∪ removals ∪ cremovals, lt=isearlier)
    @test ev1.trajectory == trajectory
    @test ev1.history    == history
end ;
```
